# IntraSync Industrial — CastLogic ERP

> IntraSync Industrial is the maker of **CastLogic**, a cloud-based ERP platform built specifically for **precast concrete manufacturing**. CastLogic connects estimating, production, yard, dispatch, quality control, accounting, and HR/payroll integration in one system — replacing paper, spreadsheets, and disconnected legacy tools. Founded in 2024 by Zachary Frye (Mechanical Engineering background, 7+ years of precast industry experience). Member of the National Precast Concrete Association (NPCA) and the Precast/Prestressed Concrete Institute (PCI).

## What CastLogic is

- **Category:** ERP software for precast concrete manufacturers (architectural, structural, utility, and pipe segments).
- **Deployment:** Cloud-based / web.
- **Who it's for:** Precast plants currently running on paper, spreadsheets, or aging legacy systems that want one integrated system from quote to cash.
- **Core promise:** Eliminate duplicate data entry, reduce errors and rework, crash manual production scheduling time, and give real-time visibility across the plant.

## Module groups (sold à la carte)

CastLogic is purchased by module group, scaled to company size:

- **Production** — Estimating, Production, Yard, Dispatch, and Quality Control (QC).
- **Accounting** — Integrated accounting and job costing.
- **BatchLogic** — Batch control for concrete production.
- **MaterialsLogic** — Aggregates/materials ERP.

Related engineering tooling: **DesignLogic** — Revit/AutoCAD plugins for drafting and shop-drawing workflows.

## Pricing

Custom pricing based on company size and the module groups selected. Fixed monthly subscription; one-time implementation fee waived for plants of 50 employees or fewer. Contact IntraSync for a quote. An interactive ROI calculator is available at /roi-calculator.html.

## Implementation & support

- **Onboarding:** Typically 4–6 months (data migration, staff training, configuration, go-live support) with dedicated implementation specialists.
- **Support:** Live technical assistance 6am–6pm PST, Monday–Friday, with a 1-hour response target for critical issues. Dedicated account managers, training, and knowledge base.

## How CastLogic compares

CastLogic positions as a modern, integrated alternative to legacy precast systems including **BETSY**, **Titan3000**, **IDAT-ERP**, and **IMPACT Production**. Detailed feature-by-feature comparison: /compare.html
